contentBlocks.text: This week you built every piece of a real engineering-design capstone. Let's put it all together!

Quick review: define your problem with real constraints (Day 1). Brainstorm and evaluate multiple solutions (Day 2). Build a testable prototype (Day 3). Iterate based on real feedback (Day 4). Combine your problem statement, chosen solution, prototype description, and one planned iteration into one complete capstone engineering-design proposal.
Great work this week — you built a complete, real engineering-design capstone proposal! Next week we'll build on these skills with something new.

objectives: Review problem definition, brainstorming/evaluation, prototyping, and iteration
Combine all four into one complete written capstone proposal
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child assemble their complete capstone proposal.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing a real engineering-design capstone proposal, ready to carry out!
differentiationTips: Struggling: it's fine if the proposal is short — focus on genuinely combining all four pieces rather than length
Ready for more: ask the child what they'd need to actually carry out this project in the real world, beyond just the written proposal
This is the week's synthesis moment — a real, usable engineering proposal the child can genuinely follow going forward, not just a review exercise
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended synthesis activity — check that the proposal genuinely combines all four elements from this week (a specific problem with a real constraint, the chosen solution, a testable prototype description, and a planned iteration) into one coherent, usable engineering-design proposal.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's NGSS Grade 9-12 Engineering Design standards (HS-ETS1-1/HS-ETS1-2/HS-ETS1-3) before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session, producing a genuinely usable final artifact rather than just a review.
